headline: Senators agree to terms with goaltender Kevin Reidler on a two-year, entry-level contract
title: Senators agree to terms with goaltender Kevin Reidler on a two-year, entry-level contract
summary:
OTTAWA – Ottawa Senators president of hockey operations and general manager Steve Staios announced today that the team has agreed to terms with goaltender Kevin Reidler on a two-year, entry-level contract set to start in the 2026-27 season.
Reidler will join the Belleville Senators on an Amateur Tryout Agreement (ATO)
body: **OTTAWA** – Ottawa Senators president of hockey operations and general manager Steve Staios announced today that the team has agreed to terms with goaltender Kevin Reidler on a two-year, entry-level contract set to start in the 2026-27 season. Reidler will join the Belleville Senators on an Amateur Tryout Agreement (ATO) contract. Reidler, 21, 6’6’’, 206 lbs, has spent the 2025-26 season with the Penn State Nittany Lions in the NCAA. In 18 games in goal, he posted an 11-7-0 record with a 3.31 goals-against average and a .901 save percentage. The Penn State men's hockey team's season came to an end on Friday with a 3-1 loss to the Minnesota-Duluth Bulldogs in the NCAA Tournament. A native of Gavle, Sweden, Reidler was selected in the 5th round (151th overall) by the Senators in the 2022 NHL Draft in Montreal. **For more information, please contact:** Sylvain St-Laurent, [stlaurents@ottawasenators.com](mailto:stlaurents@ottawasenators.com "mailto:stlaurents@ottawasenators.com") Visit the Senators website: [www.ottawasenators.com](http://www.ottawasenators.com/) Engage with the Senators on X: [@Senators](https://www.twitter.com/senators) Like the Senators on Facebook: [www.facebook.com/ottawasenators](https://www.facebook.com/ottawasenators) Follow the Senators on Instagram: [senators](https://instagram.com/senators)
